name: Constitutional Determination Audit
purpose: Identify claimed authority, controlling authority, jurisdiction, doctrine triggers, rights burdens, and constitutional invalidity before divergence is quantified.
description: CDA is the authority and doctrine engine of A.B.E. It determines whether an observed action is aligned, conflicted, ultra vires, off-mission, or void ab initio under the constitutional hierarchy of law.
hierarchy_of_law: Agency or departmental action only if delegated and within scope

inputs.name: intake_artifact
inputs.description: Original user-provided source text, jurisdiction, title, and source type.

outputs.name: claimed_authority
outputs.description: Authority claimed by the executing actor.

outputs.name: controlling_authority
outputs.description: Higher-order controlling authority under the constitutional hierarchy.

outputs.name: authority_conflict
outputs.description: Whether claimed authority conflicts with controlling authority.

outputs.name: jurisdiction_status
outputs.description: aligned, conflicted, ultra_vires, void, or unclear

outputs.name: constitutional_violation
outputs.description: Whether the observed conduct conflicts with controlling constitutional authority.

outputs.name: void_ab_initio_flag
outputs.description: Whether the act is invalid from inception under constitutional rule.

outputs.name: ultra_vires_flag
outputs.description: Whether the conduct exceeds lawful authority or jurisdiction.

outputs.name: funding_scope_conflict
outputs.description: Whether the conduct appears outside approved funding or mission scope.

outputs.name: off_mission_flag
outputs.description: Whether the conduct falls outside approved mission or funding purpose.

outputs.name: doctrine_triggers
outputs.description: Rule-of-law doctrines triggered by the conduct.

outputs.name: rights_impacted
outputs.description: Rights and liberties burdened by the conduct.

outputs.name: findings
outputs.description: Deterministic findings supporting the audit result.

state_transitions.description: Maps claimed authority against the constitutional hierarchy.
Determines whether the observed conduct is within lawful jurisdiction.
Applies ultra vires, off-mission, and void ab initio rules.

citizen_value.plain_language_role: Explains what authority was claimed, what authority actually controls, whether jurisdiction exists, what rights were burdened, and whether the act is ultra vires, off-mission, or void ab initio.
